title: Apollo / Moon-landing hoax claims
subtitle: Crewed landings are KNOWN on converging independent lines; total studio-hoax fails; NASA can still be criticised

overall.label: Landings KNOWN; total hoax UNSUPPORTED; NASA-channel dependence is real and not a disproof
overall.summary: This file is a negative control: the method must reject a weak anti-establishment claim, not only institutional failures. Apollo 11–17 landed humans on the Moon and returned them, and lunar samples, as publicly reported. The total studio-hoax claim fails a joint-fake test across independent measurement classes. Lunar laser ranging still returns from Apollo retroreflectors at published coordinates, measured by multi-national stations (Grasse, Matera, Wettzell, and others) for more than fifty years; Lunokhod 1 and 2 arrays are a parallel Soviet/French programme, not Apollo hardware. Jodrell Bank, a UK observatory, dual-tracked Apollo 11’s Eagle and the Soviet Luna 15 probe in July 1969. International laboratories have analysed Apollo samples as lunar-origin material; Soviet Luna robotic returns are a comparison class. LRO imaging of hardware and tracks at claimed sites is consistent corroboration and is NASA-family — not foreign independence. Viral flag, star, and shadow anomalies do not overturn that convergence. NASA remains the primary documentary channel for film and archives; that dependence is scored, not denied. Legitimate criticism of Apollo 1, shuttle disasters, cost, and PR culture remains open and does not rehabilitate total-hoax. Twin to Wakefield (Evidence File 004): method cuts both ways.

claims.claim: The Apollo 11–17 missions landed humans on the Moon and returned them, and lunar samples, to Earth as publicly reported. This is a convergence finding, not a single-pin finding. Load-bearing independent lines: (1) lunar laser ranging to passive Apollo retroreflector arrays still operated by multi-national ILRS stations, plus Lunokhod arrays placed by a Soviet/French programme; (2) non-US radio tracking, especially Jodrell Bank’s dual track of Apollo 11 and Luna 15 in July 1969; (3) international lunar-sample science, with Luna robotic returns as a comparison class. LRO site imaging is consistent and is not counted as a foreign line. No one line is required to be decisive alone. The pattern is.
claims.why: Wish-did-not-exist for a NASA-only conspiracy: multi-national LLR + Lunokhod parallel + Jodrell dual-track. LLR in isolation proves reflectors at lunar distance, not astronaut video — hence convergence, not isolation.

claims.claim: Popular total-hoax claims — studio filming of the landings, no crewed landings, wholesale NASA fabrication of the lunar programme as reported — fail against that convergence. A studio hypothesis must jointly fake or nullify multi-national ranging returns, UK dual-tracking of a US landing craft and a competing Soviet probe, international sample science, and the absence of a sustained Soviet technical exposure campaign during a prestige race. That conspiracy surface is larger than the landings. Motive plus NASA-channel control is not that demonstration.
claims.why: Extraordinary claim. Failure-mode independence, not purity of every document. C3 keeps the dependence steelman honest.

claims.claim: Viral anomaly lists do not disprove C1. Flag ‘waving’ is support-rod plus inertia in vacuum. Missing stars are exposure for a sunlit surface. Shadow ‘anomalies’ are perspective, terrain, and a single sun. Lost telemetry tapes are archival failure, not proof of no mission. Van Allen ‘unsurvivable’ transit remains an engineering-paper polish residual and is not scored as a C1 reversal. Photo intuition is not a discriminator.
claims.why: Pedagogy, not a second physics book. Anomalies can be discussed without promoting them to object-level disproof.

claims.claim: Much publicly cited Apollo evidence routes through NASA or contractors. Film, transcripts, and most technical archives are a US-programme channel. Frequencies and schedules were public, so foreign listeners knew where to point. That limits how ‘surprise-independent’ intercepts are. Dependence is not automatic disproof. It is a reason to score measurement operators separately from placement origin, and a reason not to treat LRO as foreign proof.
claims.why: The strongest remaining hoax steelman. Answered with failure-mode independence, not with ‘trust NASA.’

claims.claim: When multi-line independent evidence converges, continued total rejection is less rational than accepting the conventional account. Unfalsifiable ‘all of it still touches NASA somewhere’ is not a rebuttal to C1. This is the load-bearing method sentence of the negative-control chapter.
claims.why: Architectural. Twin to the Ministry’s refusal to treat institutional failure as automatic conspiracy.

claims.claim: Legitimate criticism of NASA cost, PR, risk culture, Apollo 1, Challenger, and Columbia remains possible without rehabilitating total-hoax claims. Real agency failures show the institution is not holy. They are a different proposition family from C1–C2. Smuggling programme critique into studio-hoax is a category error.
claims.why: Symmetric ruthlessness. Same rule as refusing to launder Wakefield into blanket vaccine metaphysics.

claims.claim: This file is the method twin to Wakefield / MMR (Evidence File 004). The protocol must reject a popular anti-establishment claim that fails multi-line evidence, not only claims in which institutions failed. If the book never strongly rejects an anti-establishment story, readers may suspect the method is rigged.
claims.why: 09 structural pairing. EF004 is the other negative-control specimen, narrowly scoped.

claims.claim: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter imaging of hardware and tracks at claimed landing sites is consistent with the reported locations and is limited-independence corroboration. LRO is a NASA-family sensor. It must not be sold as foreign proof. Sample chain-of-custody remains the serious academic attack surface for sophisticated sceptics — not flags and shadows. Collection was NASA; analysis is multi-lab. That residual does not currently overturn C1.
claims.why: Honesty about independence n. Hostile pass 1 in the handoff.

timeline.event: Apollo 11. Jodrell Bank dual-tracks Eagle and Soviet Luna 15. Apollo 11 retroreflector deployed at Mare Tranquillitatis.
timeline.effect: C1 / C4 — foreign RF plus hardware still ranged

timeline.effect: C1 programme, not a single mission

hypotheses.title: Crewed landings occurred as reported
hypotheses.text: Convergence of LLR, foreign RF, and sample science, with LRO as limited corroboration.

hypotheses.title: Total studio hoax
hypotheses.text: No crewed landings; the public record is fabricated.
hypotheses.test: C2. Joint-fake cost across independent groups.

hypotheses.title: Photo and radiation anomalies disprove landings
hypotheses.text: Flags, stars, shadows, Van Allen folklore overturn C1.

hypotheses.title: If NASA is the channel, nothing counts
hypotheses.text: Any confirming line that touches the US programme is worthless.
hypotheses.test: C4–C5. Measure operators separately from placement.

hypotheses.title: Hoax believers are the point of the chapter

independence: llr-apollo-arrays: Hardware placed by Apollo; ranges by FR/IT/DE/CN/US academic stations. Survives if NASA PR = 0 as an operational ranging fact.
track-jodrell: Non-US university observatory RF. Dual-track of Apollo 11 and Luna 15.
samples-apollo-labs: Collection NASA; analysis multi-institutional. Custody residual open at paper-polish level.
ussr-incentive-posture: Live competitor during Apollo 11. Motive-to-expose, not a lab pin.
openQuestions: Single geochemistry primary paper for sample-origin diagnostics — class-level KNOWN already; paper-level polish.
Van Allen belt dose engineering pin — residual; does not currently move C1.
Optional ALSJ EVA timeline exhibit for pedagogy.
Müller et al. 2019 LLR review as optional modern science pin.
wouldChange: Demonstration that multi-national LLR returns, Jodrell dual-track, and international sample science are all fabricated or systematically misread would force C1 down.
Primary evidence of a studio-scale conspiracy capable of producing that physical and international observational record would reopen C2.
A finding that this file treats all NASA-critical inquiry as heresy would be a C6 method failure, not proof of hoax.
Nothing in later NASA programme failures changes C1.

methodAudit.name: Grammar
methodAudit.note: Landings, total-hoax, anomalies-as-disproof, NASA-channel, rationality threshold, NASA-critique-without-hoax, Wakefield twin, and LRO-limited-independence are separate. ‘NASA lied’ collapses C4 with C2. ‘Mirrors prove astronauts’ isolates LLR from convergence.

methodAudit.name: Logic
methodAudit.note: H-landings best. H-studio rejected. H-anomalies rejected as established. H-nasa-taint rejected as method. H-dunk rejected. Hidden premises blocked: NASA-channel = no landings; LRO = foreign proof; agency failure = studio; flag meme = physics.

methodAudit.name: Rhetoric
methodAudit.note: Stripped: dunk culture; ‘sheeple’; ‘NASA always trustworthy.’ Neutral: converging physical and international observational lines; dependence scored; anomalies do not overturn. Identity-swap: same pins if the Cold War politics were reversed.

methodAudit.name: Reality
methodAudit.note: Discriminators: ILRS multi-station returns; Lunokhod parallel arrays; Jodrell 2009 audio of dual-track; sample-science class. Controls: LRO NASA-family; sample custody residual; Van Allen paper residual.

methodAudit.name: Independence
methodAudit.note: Placement origin ≠ measurement operator. Lunokhod is not Apollo hardware. Jodrell is not NASA. LRO is NASA-family. Dickey authors are NASA-adjacent; ILRS station list is not.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 1 — Independence overclaim
methodAudit.note: Attack: you treat LRO as foreign. Response: C8. Corroboration only.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 2 — Mirrors not astronauts
methodAudit.note: Attack: LLR proves retroreflectors, not crews. Response: true in isolation. C1 is convergence.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 3 — Dunk culture
methodAudit.note: Attack: this chapter exists to humiliate. Response: C6–C7. Steelman dependence. No sneer.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 4 — NASA critique smuggled into hoax
methodAudit.note: Attack: Apollo 1 and shuttle prove fakery. Response: C6. Different family.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 5 — TV quality
methodAudit.note: Attack: absence of live-TV quality = studio. Response: C3. Exposure and 1969 downlink limits are not a discriminator for C1.
